# Lokol Health synthetic dataset: data card

**All text in this dataset is synthetic.** It was generated by large teacher models from the
Solomon Islands Standard Treatment Manual for Children and hand-written exemplars. It contains no
real patient data, no real nurse messages, and it has not been validated by a native Pijin speaker
or a Solomon Islands clinician. It exists to teach small on-device models a fixed, auditable
protocol (ACTION / STM citation / short reply) and to measure that protocol on a held-out test set.
It is not clinical guidance.

## 1. Sources

| Source | Use | License / status |
|---|---|---|
| Ministry of Health and Medical Services, Solomon Islands. *Standard Treatment Manual for Children*, 4th edition, 2017 (125 pages, UNICEF-funded printing) | Chunked into `corpus/stm_children_chunks.jsonl` (56 sections, 183 chunks, printed pages 8-120); the chunks are the retrieval index and the "guideline excerpt" in every training prompt | No license statement in the document. Government publication, treated as copyrighted: indexed locally, cited by section and page, **not redistributed** (`data/raw/` is gitignored). The original PDF is not redistributed. Derived excerpts (the corpus chunks, the app's retrieval index and the guideline lines inside the synthetic rows) are published with citation for non-commercial demonstration, are not covered by this repo's MIT license, and will be removed on request from MHMS. |
| `pipeline/style_guide.md` | 12 hand-written gold exemplars (2 per task type plus 2 code-switching cases, 6 in Pijin), Pijin glossary, red-flag list, system prompt | MIT (this repo) |
| One verified Pijin sample sentence set (a nurse-advice paragraph) | Register model for the Pijin exemplars | MIT (this repo) |

No data from patients, clinics, DHIS2, or any messaging platform was used.

## 2. Teacher models and generation

| Teacher | Access | Share of calls | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` | River inference API (`chat_complete`, thinking disabled, temperature 0.7, max_tokens 1800; the 32 calls that truncated were re-run at 2400) | ~50% | Primary; most authentic Pijin in the pre-test |
| `nvidia/Kimi-K2.6-NVFP4` | River inference API, same settings | ~50% | Secondary, for diversity; faster |

Each call produced 5 examples as a JSON array (18 concurrent calls for the main run, 6 for the held-out run). The teacher prompt
contained: the Lokol Health system prompt and protocol, the ACTION rules and red-flag list, the
exact list of STM section titles, the Pijin style guide and glossary, 3 exemplars (2 of the same
task type), the guideline excerpt line that is placed verbatim in the user turn (built by the
script, never by the teacher), and 5 per-example seeds (age, weight, flags `rdt`/`act`/`transport`,
and an out-of-scope hint for abstain items). 75% of non-abstain items used the matching chunk,
15% a deliberately wrong chunk and 10% no chunk, so the student learns to answer `ASK_PERSON`
when retrieval fails. Qwen3.5-397B was tested as a teacher and excluded for Bislama/Tok Pisin
leakage (`mo`, `wara`). OpenAI and Anthropic models were not used for training data; headless
Claude (Sonnet) is used only as the judge.

Scripts: `pipeline/corpus.py` (chunking), `pipeline/synth.py` (generation, resumable),
`pipeline/validate.py` (checks, dedupe, split, mlx export, judge).

## 3. Task protocol

System prompt, user turn (`[lang] [rdt] [act] [transport]` flags, `[guideline: SECTION pN] excerpt`
or `[guideline: none]`, nurse message) and assistant turn (`ACTION:`, `STM:`, `---`, reply of at
most 6 short lines, or one JSON object for `note`) are defined in `docs/SPEC.md` §2 and
`pipeline/style_guide.md`. Task types: `guidance` (40%), `referral` (20%), `note` (20%),
`followup` (10%), `abstain` (10%). Languages: Solomon Islands Pijin (`pis`), English (`en`),
code-switched Pijin with English clinical terms (`mix`, flagged `lang=pis`).

## 4. Validation applied to every row

Rows were dropped when any check failed: protocol regex; `note` body is a JSON object with the
nine required keys and a matching `action` (a `note` request answered with `ASK_PERSON` in prose,
i.e. the teacher abstained because the guideline was missing or wrong, is kept but relabelled
`abstain`; 38 rows); `STM` title exists in `corpus/sections.json` (or is
`NONE`); `ASK_PERSON` requires `STM: NONE`, `ADVISE` requires a section; a red flag in the nurse
message (English and Pijin trigger lists with negation handling, plus fever under 2 months) forces
`REFER_NOW`/`REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT`; `REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT` only with `transport=next_boat`;
`abstain` rows must be `ASK_PERSON`, `referral` rows must refer; a missing or wrong guideline
without a red flag must be `ASK_PERSON`; a matching guideline with `ADVISE` must cite that
section; Pijin replies contain >= 3 glossary tokens (>= 2 for code-switched, >= 1 inside `note`
JSON); English replies contain no Pijin; no markdown; at most 6 non-empty lines; exact and
near-duplicate nurse messages removed.

## 5. Counts

Raw teacher rows: **3829**; valid after checks and dedupe: **3602**; rejected: 227 (red_flag_not_referred 90, note_json 42, referral_action 27, next_transport_flag 21, too_long 13, tok_pisin_leak 12, pijin_glossary 7, abstain_action 6, en_has_pijin 3, duplicate 2, guideline_missing_not_ask 2, note_action_mismatch 1, stm_title 1).

Splits: train **2722**, val **300**, test **300** (test contains the held-out presentations: anaemia_pallor, burns_scald, conjunctivitis, glomerulonephritis, lymph, mastoiditis, newborn_jaundice, osteomyelitis, persistent_diarrhoea, poisoning, rheumatic, skin_bakua, surgical, worms; these never appear in train or val).

## 6. Judge score (guideline faithfulness)

A random sample of **295** valid rows (300 sampled) was graded by headless Claude (`claude -p --model sonnet`, no tools) with the guideline excerpt in hand.

- Guideline faithfulness (0-3): **1.99** mean; histogram {'1': 78, '2': 134, '3': 80, '0': 3}
- ACTION judged correct: **89%**
- Pijin naturalness (0-3, Pijin rows only): **2.31**
- By teacher: {'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash': 2.07, 'Kimi-K2.6-NVFP4': 1.92}; by language: {'en': 1.97, 'pis': 2.04, 'mix': 1.85}
- Typical issues flagged: No guideline; gives paracetamol dose and oral fluids to a sleepy child instead of abstaining; IV line, 20 ml/kg saline bolus and paracetamol not in excerpt; Says IV fluids needed, but excerpt says only burns over 10% need referral; hand burn is small; no cold-water first aid; unsupported paracetamol; Reply says must go to hospital but ACTION is ADVISE; oedema is an admit sign, so REFER_NOW; salt restriction unsupported; No guideline or RDT; tells to start oral ACT to a floppy child vomiting everything, with no dose; unsupported; Abstains correctly but adds unsupported general advice

Per-item results: `data/synth/judge.jsonl`. The judge is an LLM, not a clinician; its score is a consistency check on grounding, not a clinical validation.

## 7. Cost

Teacher usage: 2,948,934 prompt tokens and 946,506 completion tokens over River (3829 raw rows, 5 per call). River list prices were not fetched during the build; at an assumed $0.30 per million prompt tokens and $1.20 per million completion tokens the run cost about **$2.02**; at ten times those rates it would be about $20. Check the River console for the billed amount. Judge cost is on the Claude subscription (headless CLI).

## 8. What this dataset does not cover (read before using)

- **Adults, pregnancy and obstetric care.** The adult Standard Treatment Manual is not public; the
  O&G manual was not used. Every adult or obstetric request is an `abstain` target.
- **Imaging, laboratory interpretation beyond RDT/blood sugar, and any diagnosis.** The assistant
  is trained to refuse and to name whom to ask.
- **Real patient data and real nurse language.** Nurse messages are teacher-written. Real
  nurse-aide messages will be shorter, noisier and more code-switched than these.
- **Native-speaker validation of Pijin.** None was done. Pijin has no official orthography;
  spellings vary in the data (`toraot`/`toroaot`, `hospitol`/`hospital`, `blong`/`blo`). Some rows
  may carry Tok Pisin or Bislama forms despite the style guide. A 10-item human spot check by a
  Pijin speaker is still an open task.
- **Dialect and regional variation** across provinces, and Solomon Islands vernacular languages
  (70+); only Pijin and English are covered.
- **Drug stock and local protocol changes after 2017.** Doses are those printed in the 4th
  edition; the manual itself defers to the national malaria guide, antibiotic and TB guidelines.
- **Teacher bias.** Both teachers are English-dominant models; the Pijin register is theirs, shaped
  by 6 hand-written exemplars and a verified paragraph. Replies tend toward a fixed structure
  (danger-sign check, test, dose, follow-up). Within-call near-duplicates were reduced by prompt
  rules and the dedupe pass but not eliminated.
- **Parser artifacts in the corpus.** `pdftotext -layout` doubled some lines on the CONVULSIONS
  pages (34-35) and flattened dose tables into space-separated columns; excerpts from those chunks
  are harder to read. The corpus is derived from the manual and is itself not redistributed.
- **Known residue after validation (verifier spot check).** 14 rows (13 train, 1 test) describe a
  brief febrile fit that has already stopped ("had a short fit at home, now awake") or "oedema long
  tufala leg" and answer `ADVISE` or `ASK_PERSON` instead of referring; the red-flag detector
  matches "fits"/"had a fit" but not "had a short fit", and not the Pijin oedema phrasing. Six rows
  (`j7-00006-0/-2/-3/-4`, `j7-00644-0`, `j8-00072-3`: 3 train, 1 val, 2 test) are flagged `lang=en`
  but reply in code-switched Pijin. Together about 0.6% of the data.
- **Safety.** The red-flag gate in the runtime (`app/src/runtime/gate.ts`, `bridge/gate.py`) is the
  control, not the model. Nothing here replaces the nurse's judgement or the referral pathway.

## 9. Files

- `data/synth/raw.jsonl`, `data/synth/raw_heldout.jsonl`: raw teacher output (all rows, before checks)
- `data/synth/{train,val,test}.jsonl`: validated splits with full metadata and `messages`
- `data/synth/rejected.jsonl`: dropped rows with the reason
- `data/synth/stats.json`, `data/synth/judge.jsonl`: counts and judge results
- `data/mlx/<size>/{train,valid,test}.jsonl`: mlx-lm chat format, identical for 0.8B/2B/4B/9B
